studies.title: Krakatoa · before 1883
studies.caption: A view of Krakatoa before the 1883 eruption reshaped the island.
studies.prompt: Historical landscape of Krakatoa BEFORE1883, viewed from a low boat-level vantage in Sunda Strait: forested volcanic island mass with a high irregular dark ridge and quiet tropical sea. No eruption, no modern Anak Krakatau cone, no modern vessels.
